title: HashiCorp Vault Batch token, HashiCorp Vault Recovery token and 1 more: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic HashiCorp Vault Batch token, HashiCorp Vault Recovery token and 1 more values built to the documented format appear in 9 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Token shape meets the provider’s prefix and minimum-length documentation, but the Vault endpoint the contract requires is absent.
